pages.task: Work out −12 ÷ −3. Hop −3 at a time from 0 until the marker lands on −12.

pages.task: 12 ÷ −3 has no hop picture. So what times −3 makes 12?
pages.why: Hops of −3 only go down, so none land on 12. But −4 × −3 = 12, as two half-turns bring 4 × 3 = 12 back to 12. So 12 ÷ −3 = −4.

pages.task: Say a ship slows steadily from 12 m/s to 4 m/s in 4 minutes, a change of −8 m/s. What is the change each minute?
pages.why: Shared evenly over 4 minutes, −8 ÷ 4 = −2, so the velocity changes by −2 m/s each minute. Check, 4 × −2 = −8. It is negative because the ship slows while moving the way counted as plus.

pages.why: 0 × −6 = 0, so 0 ÷ −6 = 0, which is neither positive nor negative. Dividing by 0 is different. No number times 0 makes 6, so 6 ÷ 0 has no answer. And 0 ÷ 0 has no one answer, since every number times 0 makes 0.

pages.task: Which division is right? Multiply back to check.
pages.why: Multiply back, −4 × −6 = 24, so 24 ÷ −6 = −4 is right. The other two multiply back to 24, not −24. In fact −24 ÷ −6 = 4 and −24 ÷ 6 = −4.
